label: Label
help: Up to ~4 characters reads best in a browser tab. The label auto-sizes to fill the icon.

label: Image
help: Optional logo or glyph shown above the label. Leave empty for a text-only icon.

label: Zoom
help: Scale the image. 100% fills the icon width; go higher to crop in tighter, lower to add a margin.

label: X
help: Nudge the image left or right.

label: Y
help: Nudge the image up or down.

label: Weight
help: Heavier weights hold up better at tiny sizes. Extra bold is the heaviest weight on offer.

label: Letter spacing
help: Negative values tuck the letters together - essential for fitting 3 or 4 monospace caps into a 16 px tile. Mono is wide, so push it well into the negatives.

label: Label size
help: Nudge the auto-fitted label size up or down (percent).

label: Show
help: Which face of the kit the canvas shows; the zip always holds every face, so this is a preview switch and a way to export one on its own. The social card exports at 1200 × 630.

label: App name
help: Full name for the PWA manifest and the social card.

label: Short name
help: Home-screen label - kept short so a phone doesn't truncate it.

label: Maskable icon
help: Add an Android adaptive icon to the kit: the art sits inside the safe zone on a full-bleed tile, so the launcher can crop it to any shape.

label: Monochrome icon
help: Add a flat single-colour silhouette to the kit, for notification badges and pinned tabs. Only its alpha is used, so the platform recolours it.

label: 16 px preview
help: Show the icon at its real 16 and 32 px favicon sizes on the canvas so you can judge legibility. An editor aid only - never included in exports.
